known_secrets.text: Multiple village systems (temple, farm, administration) were simultaneously reorganized after the Night of Ash.
Specific individuals were deliberately removed from civic records.
Some removed records correspond to physical infrastructure that still exists.
This implies intentional disconnection between memory and environment.
Partial mappings of pre-restructuring village layout are retained.
These mappings suggest additional access routes to monument-adjacent zones.
These maps have not been shared with any active authority figure.
There is no trust in centralized interpretation of the village’s past.

unknowns: Complete cause of Night of Ash
